scenario.dataWarning: One-way 15 km estimates using Dutch reference tariffs and Milieu Centraal emission factors. Parking fees, personal OV discounts, and live delays are excluded.

sources: Train tariff formula: €0.90 base + €0.169/km (NS 2nd-class distance rate)
Bus tariff formula: €1.16 boarding tariff + €0.20/km (regional OVpay rate)
Car & Bicycle: variable running/maintenance cost per 15 km trip (Nibud)
CO₂e emissions: Milieu Centraal (CE Delft, TNO & EVDB) per passenger-km
